description_en: Deletes a service address configured on a Smart Access Gateway device
description_zh: 删除智能接入网关设备配置的服务地址
kebab_example: aliyun smartag delete-service-address --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --address-type ProbeTask --address 192.168.1.1 --sag-id sag-0000 --sn sag0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteServiceAddress

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Smart Access Gateway instance is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the service address for the Smart Access Gateway instance. Set the value to ProbeTask
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例服务地址类型。仅取值：ProbeTask
parameters.name: address_type

parameters.help_en: The service address of the Smart Access Gateway instance. Example: 192.168.1.1
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例服务地址。取值如：192.168.1.1
parameters.name: address

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance
parameters.name: sag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the Smart Access Gateway device
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: sn
